description: This file defines functionality for deleting comments in a Conduit application. It includes a command class, a validator for the command, and a query handler that processes the deletion by interacting with the database context.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Contains the command, validator, and handler classes for deleting comments.

methods.description: Processes the delete command by fetching the article, validating existence, removing the comment, and saving changes.
